claims.claim: SVO IS NOT (V, G, theta): V/G/theta specify a carrier; S/V/O are slots in one utterance. theta is a budget and an object is not a budget. The mapping that holds is to the OPERATOR: subject = P, verb = G, object = Q
claims.falsifier: exhibit a reading on which an object functions as a processing budget rather than as an outcome

claims.claim: LANGUAGE HAS A THRESHOLD DISTINCT FROM ITS RULE: centre-embedding is generated by one rule applied recursively, so grammaticality is flat across depth, while peak open dependencies grow monotonically. The rule permits what the budget refuses
claims.falsifier: exhibit a centre-embedding depth where the generating rule changes, or where open dependencies do not increase with depth

claims.claim: STRIPPING PREDICATION YIELDS A BOOLEAN: every case returns a bare truth value while discarding every scope dimension it carried
claims.falsifier: exhibit a loaded predication whose stripped form retains a scope dimension

claims.claim: THE ONE-HALF TEST FIRES: a predication at degree exactly 0.5 still returns a definite boolean, because a threshold must break the tie in some direction — which is the suppressed continuity made visible
claims.falsifier: exhibit a degree-0.5 predication whose stripped form abstains

claims.claim: BOOLEAN IS THE L=0 LIMIT, NOT A RIVAL SYSTEM: stripped loaded conjunction agrees with boolean AND on every pair; the difference is that the loaded form still knows its cost and scope
claims.falsifier: exhibit a pair where stripped loaded conjunction and boolean AND disagree

claims.claim: AT ZERO LOAD WITH EMPTY SCOPE THE TWO ARE INDISTINGUISHABLE — which is the precise sense in which boolean is not wrong, only unpriced
claims.falsifier: exhibit a zero-load empty-scope pair where the loaded form carries information the boolean lacks

nonclaims: NOT claimed: that the psycholinguistic breakdown depth is established here. This suite shows a rule/budget SEPARATION; the empirical value of the threshold is external to it and is not measured.
NOT claimed: that all languages impose the same cut. SVO and SOV differ in surface order while plausibly sharing the cut, but ergative-absolutive alignment is a live test this suite does not run.
NOT claimed: that degrees in the worked predications are measurements. They are illustrative values chosen to expose the stripping operation, including the deliberate tie.
NOT claimed: that boolean logic is mistaken. It is the L=0 idealisation of predication — useful, and silent about what it cost.
suite: GRAMMAR — language as carrier, boolean as its L=0 limit
